name: Relationship & Commitment Themes Reference
note: Interpretive text for the 9 indicators engine/relationship_themes.py computes. Deliberately framed around relationship TENDENCIES in the native's own chart (restlessness, complexity, difficulty with exclusivity) rather than the word 'infidelity' anywhere in this file's text - see relationship_themes.py's own module docstring for why. No combined verdict exists anywhere in this project for this topic, matching how Mangal Dosha (manglik.py) already works: report raw indicators, let the reader weigh them, never assert a single answer.

items.title: 7th Lord in a Dusthana House
items.summary: The 7th house's own lord placed in house 6, 8, or 12 can unsettle the partnership themes it governs.
items.effects: The lord of the 7th house (marriage/partnership) sitting in a dusthana (6th - conflict, 8th - upheaval/secrets, or 12th - loss/distance) is classically read as putting some strain on how easily partnership themes play out - not a specific behavior, just a harder road for the house's own significations to express smoothly.

items.title: 7th Lord Conjunct a Natural Malefic
items.summary: A natural malefic sitting with the 7th lord can add friction or intensity to partnership themes.
items.effects: When a natural malefic (Sun, Mars, Saturn, Rahu, or Ketu) shares a house with the 7th lord, classical texts read it as coloring partnership themes with that malefic's own nature - conflict (Mars), ego friction (Sun), distance or delay (Saturn), restlessness or unconventional pulls (Rahu), or detachment (Ketu).

items.title: 7th Lord Aspected by a Natural Malefic
items.summary: Similar to a conjunction, but from a distance - a milder version of the same influence.
items.effects: A natural malefic aspecting (rather than sitting with) the 7th lord has a similar but generally milder classical reading than a direct conjunction - added pressure on partnership themes from that planet's own nature.

items.title: Venus-Mars Conjunction
items.summary: The classical significators of romantic attraction and desire sitting together - a strong, sometimes turbulent pull.
items.effects: Venus (romantic attraction, pleasure) conjunct Mars (desire, drive) is one of the more commonly discussed combinations in this area of classical astrology - read as intensified romantic/physical attraction, which some traditions associate with passionate, easily-formed bonds and others with restlessness around exclusivity. Context (which houses, which signs, other aspects) matters more than the conjunction alone.

items.title: Venus-Mars Mutual Aspect
items.summary: A milder, at-a-distance version of the Venus-Mars conjunction's themes.
items.effects: Venus and Mars aspecting each other without conjunction carries a related but generally softer version of the same themes as a direct Venus-Mars conjunction: intensified romantic/physical attraction, with the same range of classical readings.

items.title: Rahu Conjunct Venus
items.summary: A classically-discussed combination for unconventional, amplified, or restless romantic themes.
items.effects: Rahu conjunct Venus is specifically and frequently cited in classical and popular sources discussing unconventional romantic patterns, amplified desire, or restlessness with convention in relationships - Rahu tends to exaggerate and destabilize whatever it touches, and Venus governs love and attraction.

items.title: Rahu in the 7th House
items.summary: Rahu directly occupying the partnership house - a classically-cited placement for restlessness or unconventional partnership patterns.
items.effects: Rahu in the 7th house is read as bringing its own restless, boundary-pushing, amplifying nature directly into the partnership house - sometimes associated with unconventional relationship patterns, a strong pull toward partnership itself, or difficulty with settled convention.

items.title: Crowded 7th House
items.summary: Three or more planets in the 7th house - a chart with a lot happening in the partnership area.
items.effects: A 7th house with several planets in it is classically read as an area of life carrying a lot of weight and complexity - partnership themes are prominent and eventful, for better or worse depending on which planets are present and their own dignity.

items.title: Afflicted Venus
items.summary: Venus itself (romance, pleasure, values) weakened by debilitation or combustion.
items.effects: Venus debilitated or combust is read as the native's own relationship to romance, pleasure, and values being less settled or confident than usual - sometimes showing as difficulty knowing what one actually wants in a relationship, rather than pointing at any particular behavior.
